title: 同步輻射單色器
summary: 以插件磁鐵光束線上的液氮冷卻 Si(111) 雙晶單色器為對象，從布拉格條件與動力學繞射的 Darwin 寬度推導能量解析度，再處理數百瓦熱負載下的晶體變形、固定出口機構、吸收邊能量校正、穩定度預算與高次諧波抑制，最後交付一份可重現的試運轉紀錄。
summaryEn: Taking the liquid-nitrogen-cooled Si(111) double-crystal monochromator of an insertion-device beamline, derive energy resolution from the Bragg condition and the dynamical-diffraction Darwin width, then handle crystal distortion under hundreds of watts, the fixed-exit mechanism, absorption-edge energy calibration, the stability budget and harmonic rejection, ending with a reproducible commissioning record.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: Si(111) 雙晶單色器 10 keV 練習：λ = 12.398/10 = 1.2398 Å，sinθ = 1.2398/6.2712 = 0.1977，θ = 11.40°，tanθ = 0.2017。Darwin 寬度 ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad；入射垂直發散 23 µrad FWHM、液氮冷卻後熱斜率 7.7 µrad，合成角寬 √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7²) ≈ 36.2 µrad，ΔE/E ≈ 36.2×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.79×10⁻⁴，ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV。若晶體改為室溫水冷、熱斜率 350 µrad，角寬變成約 352 µrad，ΔE ≈ 17 eV 且反射率崩潰，XANES 無法進行。固定出口 H = 20 mm 時 D = 20/(2×cos11.40°) = 10.20 mm；編碼器 0.1 µrad 對應 δE ≈ 5 meV。Cu K 邊若量到 8976 eV 而非 8979 eV，零點修正 Δθ ≈ (3/8979)×tan12.72° ≈ 75 µrad。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Si(111) double-crystal exercise at 10 keV: λ = 12.398/10 = 1.2398 Å, sinθ = 1.2398/6.2712 = 0.1977, θ = 11.40°, tanθ = 0.2017. Darwin width ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad; with 23 µrad FWHM incident vertical divergence and a 7.7 µrad thermal slope after nitrogen cooling, the combined angular width is √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7²) ≈ 36.2 µrad, ΔE/E ≈ 36.2×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.79×10⁻⁴ and ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV. With a room-temperature water-cooled crystal and a 350 µrad thermal slope the width becomes about 352 µrad, ΔE ≈ 17 eV and the reflectivity collapses, making XANES impossible. For a fixed exit H = 20 mm, D = 20/(2×cos11.40°) = 10.20 mm; a 0.1 µrad encoder step corresponds to δE ≈ 5 meV. If the Cu K edge reads 8976 eV instead of 8979 eV, the zero correction is Δθ ≈ (3/8979)×tan12.72° ≈ 75 µrad. Values are teaching assumptions, not any beamline's specification.

steps.title: 布拉格條件與單色器的工作範圍：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The Bragg condition and the monochromator's working range: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 插件磁鐵送來的白光含有從數百 eV 到數十 keV 的連續光譜，單色器的工作是用完美矽單晶的晶格週期當作繞射光柵，只讓滿足布拉格條件 λ = 2d·sinθ 的波長以角度 2θ 反射出去。Si(111) 的面間距 d = 3.1356 Å，Si(311) 與 Si(511) 則用更小的 d 換取更高解析度。雙晶配置讓第二晶體把光束折回與入射平行，改變能量只需同步轉動兩晶體的布拉格角；可用能量範圍由機構能達到的最小與最大角度決定，低能端受限於大角度下晶體幾何與窗口吸收，高能端受限於小角度下的足跡與角解析度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The white beam from an insertion device carries a continuous spectrum from a few hundred eV to tens of keV; the monochromator uses the lattice period of a perfect silicon crystal as a diffraction grating so that only wavelengths satisfying the Bragg condition λ = 2d·sinθ are reflected at 2θ. Si(111) has d = 3.1356 Å, while Si(311) and Si(511) trade smaller d for higher resolution. The double-crystal arrangement lets the second crystal return the beam parallel to the incident one, so changing energy only requires rotating both crystals together; the usable range is set by the smallest and largest Bragg angles the mechanics can reach, limited at low energy by crystal geometry and window absorption at large angles and at high energy by beam footprint and angular resolution at small angles. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：λ(Å) = 12.398/E(keV)，sinθ = λ/2d，2d = 6.2712 Å。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: λ(Å) = 12.398/E(keV), sinθ = λ/2d with 2d = 6.2712 Å.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單色器像濾光片一樣吸收掉不要的波長，只讓需要的波長穿過。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A monochromator absorbs unwanted wavelengths like a filter and transmits only the wanted one." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 布拉格條件與單色器的工作範圍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The Bragg condition and the monochromator's working range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ(Å) = 12.398/E(keV)，sinθ = λ/2d，2d = 6.2712 Å。E = 10 keV：λ = 1.2398 Å，sinθ = 0.1977，θ = 11.40°；E = 4 keV：λ = 3.0995 Å，θ = 29.62°；E = 30 keV：λ = 0.4133 Å，θ = 3.78°。因此一台涵蓋 4 到 30 keV 的 Si(111) 單色器，布拉格軸行程約 26°。此結果說明布拉格角隨能量變化的幅度，直接決定測角器行程、角度解析與晶體冷卻座的設計空間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: λ(Å) = 12.398/E(keV), sinθ = λ/2d with 2d = 6.2712 Å. E = 10 keV: λ = 1.2398 Å, sinθ = 0.1977, θ = 11.40°; E = 4 keV: λ = 3.0995 Å, θ = 29.62°; E = 30 keV: λ = 0.4133 Å, θ = 3.78°. A Si(111) monochromator covering 4 to 30 keV therefore needs about 26° of Bragg-axis travel. These numbers show how far the Bragg angle swings with energy, which sets goniometer travel, angular resolution and the space available for the cooled crystal mount. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以布拉格軸編碼器讀值與公式算出的能量，對照下游離子腔量到的已知元素吸收邊（例如 Cu K 邊 8979 eV）位置，確認角度到能量的轉換在整個行程內單調且無機械間隙；再比較 Si(111) 與 Si(311) 在同一能量下的角度差是否符合 d 值比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the energy computed from the Bragg-axis encoder with the positions of known absorption edges measured in the downstream ion chamber, such as the Cu K edge at 8979 eV, confirming that the angle-to-energy conversion is monotonic without backlash over the whole travel; then check that the angle difference between Si(111) and Si(311) at one energy matches the ratio of d values.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 布拉格條件與單色器的工作範圍：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The Bragg condition and the monochromator's working range: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以布拉格軸編碼器讀值與公式算出的能量，對照下游離子腔量到的已知元素吸收邊（例如 Cu K 邊 8979 eV）位置，確認角度到能量的轉換在整個行程內單調且無機械間隙；再比較 Si(111) 與 Si(311) 在同一能量下的角度差是否符合 d 值比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the energy computed from the Bragg-axis encoder with the positions of known absorption edges measured in the downstream ion chamber, such as the Cu K edge at 8979 eV, confirming that the angle-to-energy conversion is monotonic without backlash over the whole travel; then check that the angle difference between Si(111) and Si(311) at one energy matches the ratio of d values. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把編碼器零點直接當作 θ = 0 而不做吸收邊校正，整條能量軸系統性偏移數 eV，XAFS 量測的邊位置與文獻對不上，所有化學態判讀都錯位。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Taking the encoder zero as θ = 0 without an absorption-edge calibration shifts the entire energy axis by several eV, so XAFS edge positions disagree with the literature and every chemical-state assignment is displaced.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.titleEn: The Bragg condition and the monochromator's working range: failure diagnosis

steps.title: 動力學繞射、Darwin 寬度與能量解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Dynamical diffraction, Darwin width and energy resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Darwin 反射曲線與 DuMond 圖」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Darwin reflectivity curve and the DuMond diagram” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完美晶體的布拉格反射不是無限窄的 δ 函數：動力學繞射理論顯示在一個有限角度範圍內反射率接近 100%，這個範圍稱為 Darwin 寬度，由結構因子、波長與偏振決定，Si(111) 的相對寬度 ΔE/E 約 1.3×10⁻⁴，幾乎與能量無關。單色器輸出的能量頻寬是 Darwin 寬度與入射光束發散角在角度空間的卷積，再透過微分布拉格式 ΔE/E = cotθ·Δθ 轉成能量；低能量大角度時 cotθ 小，解析度較好，高能量小角度時同樣的角度誤差放大成更大的能量誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Darwin 反射曲線與 DuMond 圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A perfect-crystal Bragg reflection is not an infinitely narrow delta function: dynamical diffraction theory shows near-100% reflectivity over a finite angular range, the Darwin width, set by the structure factor, wavelength and polarisation; for Si(111) the relative width ΔE/E is about 1.3×10⁻⁴ and nearly independent of energy. The output bandwidth is the convolution in angle of the Darwin width with the incident beam divergence, converted to energy through the differentiated Bragg law ΔE/E = cotθ·Δθ; at low energy and large angle cotθ is small and resolution is good, while at high energy and small angle the same angular error becomes a larger energy error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Darwin reflectivity curve and the DuMond diagram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完美晶體只反射一個精確波長，解析度由機械精度決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 動力學繞射、Darwin 寬度與能量解析度：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Darwin 反射曲線與 DuMond 圖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Darwin reflectivity curve and the DuMond diagram” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：10 keV、θ = 11.40°、tanθ = 0.2017：Si(111) 的 Darwin 寬度 ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad（約 5.5 角秒）。若聚頻磁鐵垂直發散 FWHM 為 23 µrad，合成角寬 √(26.8² + 23²) ≈ 35.3 µrad，ΔE/E = 35.3×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.75×10⁻⁴，即 ΔE ≈ 1.75 eV；把上游狹縫收到發散 5 µrad，則 ΔE/E ≈ 1.35×10⁻⁴，ΔE ≈ 1.35 eV，逼近晶體本徵極限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 10 keV, θ = 11.40° and tanθ = 0.2017: the Si(111) Darwin width is ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad (about 5.5 arcsec). With an undulator vertical divergence of 23 µrad FWHM the combined angular width is √(26.8² + 23²) ≈ 35.3 µrad, so ΔE/E = 35.3×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.75×10⁻⁴, i.e. ΔE ≈ 1.75 eV; closing the upstream slit to 5 µrad divergence gives ΔE/E ≈ 1.35×10⁻⁴ and ΔE ≈ 1.35 eV, close to the intrinsic crystal limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：固定第一晶體，以壓電驅動第二晶體掃描俯仰角並記錄離子腔強度，得到雙晶搖擺曲線；其寬度應接近兩條 Darwin 曲線的自相關寬度加上發散貢獻，若量到的寬度明顯大於計算值（例如 45 µrad 對 35 µrad），就表示晶體受應變或熱變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: With the first crystal fixed, scan the second crystal's pitch with the piezo while recording the ion-chamber intensity to obtain the double-crystal rocking curve; its width should approach the autocorrelation width of two Darwin curves plus the divergence term, and a measured width clearly above the calculation (say 45 µrad against 35 µrad) indicates strained or thermally distorted crystals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「液氮冷卻塊與熱凸起」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Liquid-nitrogen cooling block and thermal bump” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 第一晶體承受插件磁鐵白光中數百瓦的吸收功率，功率集中在數平方毫米的足跡內，形成局部溫升與熱凸起；凸起的斜率誤差一旦與 Darwin 寬度同量級，反射率下降、頻寬變寬、出射方向偏移。矽的熱性能指標是熱導率與熱膨脹係數之比 κ/α：室溫下 κ ≈ 148 W/(m·K)、α ≈ 2.6×10⁻⁶/K；降到 77 K 時 κ 升到約 1300 W/(m·K)，α 變成約 −0.5×10⁻⁶/K（在約 125 K 穿越零點），κ/α 改善四十倍以上。因此第一晶體以液氮直接或間接冷卻，第二晶體可為間接冷卻或銅辮熱連接。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「液氮冷卻塊與熱凸起」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The first crystal absorbs hundreds of watts of the insertion-device white beam concentrated in a footprint of a few square millimetres, producing a local temperature rise and a thermal bump; once the bump's slope error is comparable to the Darwin width, reflectivity drops, bandwidth widens and the exit direction shifts. Silicon's thermal figure of merit is the ratio of conductivity to expansion coefficient κ/α: at room temperature κ ≈ 148 W/(m·K) and α ≈ 2.6×10⁻⁶/K; at 77 K κ rises to about 1300 W/(m·K) while α becomes about −0.5×10⁻⁶/K (crossing zero near 125 K), improving κ/α by more than forty times. The first crystal is therefore cooled directly or indirectly by liquid nitrogen, and the second by indirect cooling or copper braids. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Liquid-nitrogen cooling block and thermal bump”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一維量級估計：熱凸起斜率 ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L)，P 為吸收功率、L 為沿光束方向的足跡長度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One-dimensional order-of-magnitude estimate: thermal-bump slope ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L), with P the absorbed power and L the footprint length along the beam.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「矽晶體夠厚、熱容夠大，幾百瓦的熱負載不會改變反射。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thick silicon crystal has enough heat capacity that a few hundred watts cannot alter the reflection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「液氮冷卻塊與熱凸起」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 高熱負載下的矽晶體與液氮冷卻：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Silicon crystals under high heat load and liquid-nitrogen cooling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「液氮冷卻塊與熱凸起」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Liquid-nitrogen cooling block and thermal bump” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一維量級估計：熱凸起斜率 ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L)，P 為吸收功率、L 為沿光束方向的足跡長度。P = 200 W，2 mm 高的光束在 θ = 11.4° 下足跡 L = 2/0.1977 ≈ 10 mm，P/L = 2×10⁴ W/m。室溫：α/κ = 2.6×10⁻⁶/148 ≈ 1.76×10⁻⁸ m/W，斜率 ≈ 350 µrad，是 Darwin 寬度 27 µrad 的十三倍，反射幾乎崩潰；77 K：|α/κ| = 0.5×10⁻⁶/1300 ≈ 3.8×10⁻¹⁰ m/W，斜率 ≈ 7.7 µrad，約 Darwin 寬度的 0.3 倍，可接受（精確值需有限元素分析）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One-dimensional order-of-magnitude estimate: thermal-bump slope ≈ (α/κ)·(P/L), with P the absorbed power and L the footprint length along the beam. P = 200 W; a 2 mm tall beam at θ = 11.4° has footprint L = 2/0.1977 ≈ 10 mm, so P/L = 2×10⁴ W/m. Room temperature: α/κ = 2.6×10⁻⁶/148 ≈ 1.76×10⁻⁸ m/W, slope ≈ 350 µrad, thirteen times the 27 µrad Darwin width and the reflection collapses; at 77 K: |α/κ| = 0.5×10⁻⁶/1300 ≈ 3.8×10⁻¹⁰ m/W, slope ≈ 7.7 µrad, about 0.3 Darwin widths and acceptable (exact values need finite-element analysis). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同儲存環電流（即不同吸收功率）下量雙晶搖擺曲線的寬度與峰值位置，畫出寬度對功率的曲線；若寬度隨功率線性增加且峰值位置偏移，就是熱凸起的指紋；同時監測晶體溫度感測器與液氮流量，確認晶體維持在約 80 K。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the double-crystal rocking-curve width and peak position at several ring currents (hence absorbed powers) and plot width against power; a width that grows linearly with power together with a shifting peak is the fingerprint of the thermal bump; monitor the crystal thermocouples and nitrogen flow at the same time to confirm the crystal stays near 80 K.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 在不同儲存環電流（即不同吸收功率）下量雙晶搖擺曲線的寬度與峰值位置，畫出寬度對功率的曲線；若寬度隨功率線性增加且峰值位置偏移，就是熱凸起的指紋；同時監測晶體溫度感測器與液氮流量，確認晶體維持在約 80 K。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 晶體安裝、固定出口幾何與角度解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Crystal mounting, fixed-exit geometry and angular resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「固定出口機構與布拉格軸編碼器」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。

steps.instruction: 晶體必須以無應變方式夾持，任何夾持力都會彎曲晶格、讓 Darwin 曲線變寬；常見做法是重力或輕壓的運動學支撐、銦箔熱界面與對稱的夾具。兩晶體平行且相隔垂直距離 D 時，出射光束相對入射光束的高度偏移為 H = 2D·cosθ；要在改變能量時維持固定出口高度，D 必須隨 θ 改變，由第二晶體的平移台完成。整個晶體籠裝在布拉格軸上，由真空內步進或伺服馬達驅動，高解析度編碼器讀取角度；第二晶體另有壓電俯仰與滾轉微調。所有機構都在高真空中並承受液氮管路的熱收縮。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「固定出口機構與布拉格軸編碼器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crystals must be held strain-free, since any clamping force bends the lattice and widens the Darwin curve; common practice uses gravity or lightly loaded kinematic supports, indium-foil thermal interfaces and symmetric fixtures. With the two crystals parallel and separated by a perpendicular gap D, the exit beam is offset from the incident one by H = 2D·cosθ; keeping a fixed exit height while changing energy requires D to vary with θ, done by the second crystal's translation stage. The crystal cage sits on the Bragg axis driven by in-vacuum stepper or servo motors with a high-resolution encoder, and the second crystal carries piezo pitch and roll fine adjustments. Everything operates in high vacuum while coping with the thermal contraction of the nitrogen lines. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fixed-exit mechanism and Bragg-axis encoder”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：固定出口高度 H = 20 mm：D = H/(2cosθ)，30 keV（θ = 3.78°）時 D = 10.02 mm，4 keV（θ = 29.62°）時 D = 11.50 mm，平移行程約 1.5 mm；D 誤差 10 µm 使出口高度偏 2×10 µm×cosθ ≈ 20 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fixed exit height H = 20 mm: D = H/(2cosθ), giving D = 10.02 mm at 30 keV (θ = 3.78°) and 11.50 mm at 4 keV (θ = 29.62°), a translation range of about 1.5 mm; a 10 µm error in D shifts the exit height by 2×10 µm×cosθ ≈ 20 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要兩晶體平行，出口光束的高度就與能量無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the two crystals are parallel, the exit height does not depend on energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fixed-exit mechanism and Bragg-axis encoder” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：固定出口高度 H = 20 mm：D = H/(2cosθ)，30 keV（θ = 3.78°）時 D = 10.02 mm，4 keV（θ = 29.62°）時 D = 11.50 mm，平移行程約 1.5 mm；D 誤差 10 µm 使出口高度偏 2×10 µm×cosθ ≈ 20 µm。角度解析度轉成能量步長：δE = E·cotθ·δθ，在 10 keV、cotθ = 4.96、編碼器解析度 0.1 µrad 時 δE ≈ 10⁴×4.96×10⁻⁷ ≈ 5 meV，足以支撐 1 eV 等級的頻寬掃描。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fixed exit height H = 20 mm: D = H/(2cosθ), giving D = 10.02 mm at 30 keV (θ = 3.78°) and 11.50 mm at 4 keV (θ = 29.62°), a translation range of about 1.5 mm; a 10 µm error in D shifts the exit height by 2×10 µm×cosθ ≈ 20 µm. steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝晶體後在實驗室以雷射自準直儀量夾持前後的反射面傾斜變化，應小於 1 µrad；上線後用下游四象限光束位置偵測器在整個能量範圍掃描，記錄出口高度對能量的曲線，殘差應在 ±10 µm 內；以自準直儀或干涉儀檢查編碼器的線性與回差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After mounting, measure with a laser autocollimator the change in reflecting-surface tilt before and after clamping, which should stay below 1 µrad; once installed, scan the whole energy range while a downstream quadrant beam-position detector records exit height against energy, with residuals within ±10 µm; check encoder linearity and backlash with an autocollimator or interferometer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Energy calibration, rocking-curve measurement and peak locking: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「吸收邊能量校正與 I₀ 離子腔」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Absorption-edge calibration and the I₀ ion chamber” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 能量軸的絕對校正用金屬箔的 K 邊或 L 邊：在單色器後放離子腔 I₀、箔與離子腔 I₁，掃描能量並取 ln(I₀/I₁) 的一階導數極大值為邊位置，與公認值比較，把差異換算成布拉格角偏移修正編碼器零點。多個吸收邊可同時檢查能量軸的線性。日常運轉中第二晶體的平行度用峰值鎖定回授維持：把第二晶體俯仰停在搖擺曲線的斜坡或以抖動法鎖在峰頂，補償熱漂移。還要記錄多束繞射造成的「毛刺」能量位置，避免誤判為樣品訊號。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「吸收邊能量校正與 I₀ 離子腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Absolute energy calibration uses the K or L edges of metal foils: with an ion chamber I₀, the foil and an ion chamber I₁ behind the monochromator, scan energy, take the maximum of the first derivative of ln(I₀/I₁) as the edge position, compare with the accepted value and convert the difference into a Bragg-angle correction of the encoder zero. Several edges together check the linearity of the energy axis. In routine operation the second crystal's parallelism is held by peak-locking feedback, either parking its pitch on the rocking-curve flank or dithering to lock on the peak, compensating thermal drift. The energies of multiple-beam diffraction 'glitches' are also logged so they are not mistaken for sample features. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Absorption-edge calibration and the I₀ ion chamber”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Cu K 邊公認值 8979 eV，θ = 12.72°、tanθ = 0.2257；若量到 8976 eV（偏 −3 eV），由 ΔE/E = −cotθ·Δθ 得 |Δθ| = (3/8979)×0.2257 ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 75 µrad ≈ 15.6 角秒，須把編碼器零點修正這個量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The accepted Cu K edge is 8979 eV, with θ = 12.72° and tanθ = 0.2257; a measured 8976 eV (−3 eV) gives, from ΔE/E = −cotθ·Δθ, |Δθ| = (3/8979)×0.2257 ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 75 µrad ≈ 15.6 arcsec, which must be applied to the encoder zero.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「矽的 d 值是常數，所以能量軸不需要用樣品校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Silicon's d-spacing is a constant, so the energy axis needs no calibration against a sample." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「吸收邊能量校正與 I₀ 離子腔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 能量校正、搖擺曲線量測與峰值鎖定：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吸收邊能量校正與 I₀ 離子腔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Absorption-edge calibration and the I₀ ion chamber” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Cu K 邊公認值 8979 eV，θ = 12.72°、tanθ = 0.2257；若量到 8976 eV（偏 −3 eV），由 ΔE/E = −cotθ·Δθ 得 |Δθ| = (3/8979)×0.2257 ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 75 µrad ≈ 15.6 角秒，須把編碼器零點修正這個量。若同時 Fe K 邊（7112 eV）偏 −2.4 eV、Zn K 邊（9659 eV）偏 −3.2 eV，三者換算出的 Δθ 一致，表示是零點誤差而非 d 值或機械非線性。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The accepted Cu K edge is 8979 eV, with θ = 12.72° and tanθ = 0.2257; a measured 8976 eV (−3 eV) gives, from ΔE/E = −cotθ·Δθ, |Δθ| = (3/8979)×0.2257 ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 75 µrad ≈ 15.6 arcsec, which must be applied to the encoder zero. If the Fe K edge (7112 eV) reads −2.4 eV and the Zn K edge (9659 eV) reads −3.2 eV at the same time, the three convert to the same Δθ, indicating a zero offset rather than a d-spacing or mechanical nonlinearity error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次更換晶體或維修後掃描至少三個吸收邊，擬合編碼器零點與可能的尺度因子；把擬合殘差列在校正紀錄中並要求小於 0.2 eV；再以搖擺曲線掃描量出寬度並與單元 2 的計算值比較，作為晶體狀態的健康指標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After every crystal change or maintenance scan at least three absorption edges and fit the encoder zero plus any scale factor; list the fit residuals in the calibration record and require them below 0.2 eV; then scan the rocking curve, measure its width and compare with the unit-2 calculation as a crystal-health indicator.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 高次諧波抑制與光束線整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Harmonic rejection and beamline integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「諧波抑制鏡與失諧第二晶體」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Harmonic-rejection mirror and detuned second crystal” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Si(111) 在選定 10 keV 時也同時以 (333) 反射讓 30 keV 通過（(222) 在鑽石結構中為禁制反射），高次諧波會污染吸收光譜與繞射資料。兩種抑制方法互補：一是把第二晶體稍微失諧，因為高次反射的 Darwin 寬度窄得多，失諧幾微弧度就能大幅抑制諧波而只損失部分基頻；二是在單色器後放一對掠角反射鏡，利用全外反射的臨界角與能量成反比的性質，把高於截止能量的光子拒於門外。整合時還要考慮上游白光狹縫定義功率與發散、鈹窗、下游聚焦鏡與實驗站的光束位置偵測器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「諧波抑制鏡與失諧第二晶體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With Si(111) set to 10 keV the (333) reflection also passes 30 keV ((222) is forbidden in the diamond structure), and higher harmonics contaminate absorption spectra and diffraction data. Two complementary suppression methods exist: detuning the second crystal slightly, since the harmonic Darwin width is far narrower, so a few microradians of detuning strongly suppresses the harmonic while costing only part of the fundamental; and a pair of grazing-incidence mirrors after the monochromator, exploiting the fact that the total-external-reflection critical angle scales inversely with energy, so photons above the cutoff energy are rejected. Integration also covers the upstream white-beam slit that defines power and divergence, beryllium windows, downstream focusing mirrors and the beam-position detectors in the experimental station. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Harmonic-rejection mirror and detuned second crystal”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：銠鍍膜鏡在 10 keV 的臨界角由 θ_c = √(2δ) 算得：δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵，θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad；鏡子固定在 3 mrad 掠角時截止能量 E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV，10 keV 基頻反射率約 0.9，而 30 keV 的三次諧波遠高於截止而被抑制到 10⁻³ 以下。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a rhodium-coated mirror at 10 keV the critical angle follows θ_c = √(2δ): δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵ gives θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad; with the mirror fixed at a 3 mrad glancing angle the cutoff is E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV, the 10 keV fundamental reflects at about 0.9, and the 30 keV third harmonic lies far above the cutoff and is suppressed below 10⁻³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單色器輸出只有一個能量，不會有其他能量混入。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A monochromator outputs a single energy with nothing else mixed in." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「諧波抑制鏡與失諧第二晶體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Harmonic-rejection mirror and detuned second crystal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 高次諧波抑制與光束線整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Harmonic rejection and beamline integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「諧波抑制鏡與失諧第二晶體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Harmonic-rejection mirror and detuned second crystal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：銠鍍膜鏡在 10 keV 的臨界角由 θ_c = √(2δ) 算得：δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵，θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad；鏡子固定在 3 mrad 掠角時截止能量 E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV，10 keV 基頻反射率約 0.9，而 30 keV 的三次諧波遠高於截止而被抑制到 10⁻³ 以下。失諧法：Si(333) 的 ΔE/E ≈ 1×10⁻⁵，在 θ = 11.4° 的角寬只有約 2 µrad，第二晶體失諧 10 µrad 時基頻約保留 70%，諧波降到約 1%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a rhodium-coated mirror at 10 keV the critical angle follows θ_c = √(2δ): δ ≈ 2.25×10⁻⁵ gives θ_c ≈ 6.7 mrad; with the mirror fixed at a 3 mrad glancing angle the cutoff is E_c ≈ 10 keV×6.7/3 ≈ 22 keV, the 10 keV fundamental reflects at about 0.9, and the 30 keV third harmonic lies far above the cutoff and is suppressed below 10⁻³. Detuning: Si(333) has ΔE/E ≈ 1×10⁻⁵, an angular width of only about 2 µrad at θ = 11.4°, so detuning the second crystal by 10 µrad keeps about 70% of the fundamental while the harmonic drops to about 1%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用薄箔的透射比在基頻與三倍頻能量下差異很大的特性，或用能量解析偵測器直接量諧波比例，分別在失諧 0、5、10 µrad 與鏡子開關下記錄；確認基頻損失與諧波抑制符合預期，並把最佳失諧量寫入自動化程序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a thin foil whose transmission differs strongly between the fundamental and the third harmonic, or an energy-resolving detector, to measure the harmonic fraction at detuning 0, 5 and 10 µrad and with the mirror in and out; confirm that fundamental loss and harmonic suppression behave as expected and store the optimum detuning in the automation sequence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 長期漂移驗證與工程交接：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」如何決定同步輻射單色器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds” determines the key performance of “Synchrotron monochromators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 交接時要證明單色器在數天尺度上仍符合規格：能量漂移（以重複掃描吸收邊追蹤）、強度穩定（與儲存環電流正規化後的 I₀ 漂移）、出射位置漂移與液氮系統的溫度紀錄。能量漂移主要來自晶體溫度改變面間距與機構的熱膨脹；液氮冷卻的好處之一是矽在 77 K 的膨脹係數很小，但布拉格軸的鋼製機構仍以約 12×10⁻⁶/K 膨脹，必須靠環境溫控。文件包含能量校正表、搖擺曲線基準、毛刺能量表、最佳失諧量、連鎖門檻（晶體溫度、液氮流量、真空）與維護程序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Handoff must show that the monochromator still meets specification over days: energy drift (tracked by repeated edge scans), intensity stability (I₀ drift after normalising to ring current), exit-position drift and the temperature log of the nitrogen system. Energy drift comes mainly from crystal temperature changing the d-spacing and from thermal expansion of the mechanics; one benefit of nitrogen cooling is silicon's tiny expansion coefficient at 77 K, but the steel Bragg-axis mechanics still expand at about 12×10⁻⁶/K and rely on environmental temperature control. The documentation holds the energy-calibration table, rocking-curve baseline, glitch-energy table, optimum detuning, interlock thresholds (crystal temperature, nitrogen flow, vacuum) and maintenance procedures. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：晶體溫度漂移：ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Crystal temperature drift: ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「液氮冷卻後晶體溫度不變，能量軸就不會再漂移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 長期漂移驗證與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：晶體溫度漂移：ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT。77 K 下 α ≈ −0.5×10⁻⁶/K，ΔT = +2 K 給 ΔE/E = +1×10⁻⁶，10 keV 時 +10 meV；室溫晶體（α = 2.6×10⁻⁶/K）同樣 2 K 則漂移 −52 meV。機構：鋼製 100 mm 臂長溫變 0.1 K 伸長 0.12 µm，相當於約 1.2 µrad 的角度，ΔE = 10 keV×4.96×1.2×10⁻⁶ ≈ 60 meV，是晶體項的六倍，所以機櫃與棚屋溫控到 ±0.1 K 是驗收條件。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Crystal temperature drift: ΔE/E = −Δd/d = −α·ΔT. At 77 K with α ≈ −0.5×10⁻⁶/K, ΔT = +2 K gives ΔE/E = +1×10⁻⁶, i.e. +10 meV at 10 keV; a room-temperature crystal (α = 2.6×10⁻⁶/K) drifts −52 meV for the same 2 K. Mechanics: a 100 mm steel arm changing by 0.1 K lengthens by 0.12 µm, roughly 1.2 µrad of angle, so ΔE = 10 keV×4.96×1.2×10⁻⁶ ≈ 60 meV, six times the crystal term, which is why hutch and rack temperature control to ±0.1 K is an acceptance condition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：連續 72 小時每 2 小時自動掃描 Cu K 邊，記錄邊位置、I₀/電流與出射位置，同時記錄棚屋溫度；要求能量漂移峰對峰 < 100 meV、強度漂移 < 2%、位置漂移 < 20 µm，並檢查漂移與溫度的相關係數以判定主因；試運轉報告附上所有原始掃描檔與分析腳本。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For 72 hours automatically scan the Cu K edge every 2 hours, logging edge position, I₀ per unit ring current and exit position together with hutch temperature; require peak-to-peak energy drift < 100 meV, intensity drift < 2% and position drift < 20 µm, and use the correlation with temperature to identify the dominant cause; attach all raw scans and analysis scripts to the commissioning report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。

steps.title: 長期漂移驗證與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 連續 72 小時每 2 小時自動掃描 Cu K 邊，記錄邊位置、I₀/電流與出射位置，同時記錄棚屋溫度；要求能量漂移峰對峰 < 100 meV、強度漂移 < 2%、位置漂移 < 20 µm，並檢查漂移與溫度的相關係數以判定主因；試運轉報告附上所有原始掃描檔與分析腳本。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For 72 hours automatically scan the Cu K edge every 2 hours, logging edge position, I₀ per unit ring current and exit position together with hutch temperature; require peak-to-peak energy drift < 100 meV, intensity drift < 2% and position drift < 20 µm, and use the correlation with temperature to identify the dominant cause; attach all raw scans and analysis scripts to the commissioning report. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：空調在夜間切換模式使棚屋溫度每晚變化 1 K，能量軸隨之擺動 0.5 eV；交接時只在白天做驗收，使用者的隔夜長時間掃描出現無法重現的邊位移，數月後才追溯到溫控。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Night-time air-conditioning mode changes swing the hutch temperature by 1 K every evening and the energy axis by 0.5 eV; acceptance was done only by day, so users' overnight scans show irreproducible edge shifts traced to temperature control only months later.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 連續 72 小時每 2 小時自動掃描 Cu K 邊，記錄邊位置、I₀/電流與出射位置，同時記錄棚屋溫度；要求能量漂移峰對峰 < 100 meV、強度漂移 < 2%、位置漂移 < 20 µm，並檢查漂移與溫度的相關係數以判定主因；試運轉報告附上所有原始掃描檔與分析腳本。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期漂移驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff"?

steps.title: 長期漂移驗證與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試運轉紀錄與連鎖門檻」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Commissioning record and interlock thresholds” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 空調在夜間切換模式使棚屋溫度每晚變化 1 K，能量軸隨之擺動 0.5 eV；交接時只在白天做驗收，使用者的隔夜長時間掃描出現無法重現的邊位移，數月後才追溯到溫控。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Night-time air-conditioning mode changes swing the hutch temperature by 1 K every evening and the energy axis by 0.5 eV; acceptance was done only by day, so users' overnight scans show irreproducible edge shifts traced to temperature control only months later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：文件包含能量校正表、搖擺曲線基準、毛刺能量表、最佳失諧量、連鎖門檻（晶體溫度、液氮流量、真空）與維護程序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The documentation holds the energy-calibration table, rocking-curve baseline, glitch-energy table, optimum detuning, interlock thresholds (crystal temperature, nitrogen flow, vacuum) and maintenance procedures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「液氮冷卻後晶體溫度不變，能量軸就不會再漂移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With nitrogen cooling the crystal temperature is fixed, so the energy axis cannot drift." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期漂移驗證與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term drift validation and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
單色器像濾光片一樣吸收掉不要的波長，只讓需要的波長穿過。

A monochromator absorbs unwanted wavelengths like a filter and transmits only the wanted one.
